The business's best real photographs. The files are in `images/` (a
website's are in `static/images/`). Look at each once and describe it in
its row, with the picture shown (`![what it shows](images/<file>)`,
relative to this note). Later, read this file instead of opening the
pictures. One line per file. Use the focal point as `object-position` when
a picture is cropped. Use a picture in an ad only when its "OK for ads"
column is yes.
